verdict.rationale: Factory states you can monitor active missions, track worker progress, and view detailed execution logs in real time. That directly covers watching a running agent and its status. Supporting evidence includes a sessions API for managing session lifecycle, session filtering across projects and machines, and outputs rendered beside the session that produced them. Missing for 10: explicit real-time status visibility for ordinary (non-Mission) sessions, in-depth docs on what status states are shown, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
